card.name: The word see in cross-references
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "see" right after an opening bracket that points to another label section, such as [see Warnings and Precautions. Weaker hits on scattered words such as "said" after a quote.

modes.label: Bracketed cross-reference
modes.description: The word "see" opens a pointer to another section of the drug label.
modes.example: No Grade 4 rash was reported [<<see>> Adverse Reactions ( 6.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Occasional hits on a speech verb or a partial term, with no shared theme.
modes.example: in a statement today. Today’s announcement
